ports.note: Every port a chart can draw, declared always, and none of them required. A chart draws what it is given, so which ports exist is not a question for the practitioner to answer before they have the shape -- the treatment map_output took on 2026-10-14 and table_output on 2026-10-27. `series` remains reachable only on a workflow saved with inputMode 'series'; a Cases by period table connected to `records` draws the same curve, because the shape that arrives decides and not the port it arrived on.

ontology.note: Existing ontology alignment; full configuration and port shape contracts remain to be defined. The transmission tree asserts fw:TransmissionTree with its columns and counts, declared in ontology/runtime.ttl; listed here as none because this widget is defined in core.ts#TYPES, which the coupling check cannot attribute.

changes.description: Draws a transmission tree (experiment 200; the practitioner, 2026-11-09: "I still don't see the transmission chain chart for hagelloch"): Draw, in Configure…, offers Transmission tree, with the columns naming each case, its infector and its date. Each case is a dot at its date on a row of its own, joined from its infector, so the length across is the serial interval; a case naming no infector starts a chain. Cases naming an infector the table does not hold, cases in a loop and cases without a date are each counted, never dropped. Receipt: fw:TransmissionTree with its columns and counts. On the standard Inspector and dialog (experiment 186): the name and its place in the write-up, the inputs, one sentence and Configure…, which holds every setting the three old panels held under the same ids, and what the last run drew.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.8.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid.
